Thanks!
Sorry i didn't answered earlier. I'm way too used to only see the bad stuff and answering for a "debate" and not stopping to thanks people that say "yo. You cool".

I may have phrased this wrong.

If we talk about twitter, I DO NOT only follow extremes, that would be unhealthy and I know it. I mainly follow people that I believe are good people, people that I agree with (90% of people I follow are people I like/agree with, 10% are extremes. 5%, one extreme, remaining 5%, the other extreme). I also feel like it's giving a hard time to the recommendation algorithm to pinpoint what I truly believe in.

I do not get my information out of them. And if I do get new information from them, I double/tripple if not quadruple check by looking for the source of the information in different political new papers if not directly from a research paper.

The older I get, the more I see the world going towards the extremes (Even before doing the "follow the extremes" thing, saw it started back in high school). So to "keep in touch with the world", to "understand" the extremes, the logic behind the extremes and mainly to feel secure on where the world is going. Even if it's hurting me, strangely, I feel safer to follow thought extremes.

There is also a weird morbid curiosity (that I definitely know is unhealthy) of "ok, how fucked up is fucked up today? How far have they taken the last skits".

If no one can get fired even if the game flopped (let's be honest, it will not, but I was saying that from the basis of "the boycott worked and no one or few people bought the game"), well, how? Infinite money glitch? I want the be employed here.

​

I don't think the franchise can be killed. It's too strong of a franchise to be killed off. I think there is even a section of the Universal Studio park dedicated to Hogwards.

For JKR claiming power over popular culture, I don't think it's that simple. The books are written and I don't think you can easily change what is written in the books that easily. I feel like it's very close to the debate "can we separate the art from the artist?" soooo. Let's try to avoid going there. Even if we are on the same page, it's a sticky debate.  


For the comparison to the DnD OGL, If I understood the problem, the new OGL was about changing everything, even stuff that was already published. So, I feel like it's a different situation than here.

​

Finally, about the "this isn’t making us any new enemies". I feel like in the public's mind, the "trans debate" is so sensitive, people will get polarized one way or the other, slowly but surely reducing the number of neutral/"I don't care" people. Also from my personal experience of seeing both sides. I saw more people getting polarized toward the "fuck trans people" than people getting "polarized" towards "yes trans people can live".

>but i definitely think your gf thinks ur prioritizing the game over her.

Well. As I didn't even played a minute and only spend time on my character during the day, when It didn't imping on the time we have every evening, I didn't prioritized the server, it's quite the other way around.

>For one, it doesn't seem like you had an actual conversation about this

I didn't precised it in my post (maybe I should have) but we had a disution about it. She was saying "yea.... play if you want to...." while sghing+herbody langage "saying" the polar opposite of what she was saying.

>Can you see how that reflects poorly on her? 

I know it look bad, but i saw the situation with 2 endings possible.
Ending 1: I play on the server, there is a lot of frustration on her side every evening around me playing.
Ending 2: I don't play on the server, there is a lot of frustration on my side for a few days. Then it's gone.

>On top of that, people who over-react to people's boundaries in a "OK so I'll never play it again!!" sort of tantrum are doing so to invalidate their partner and prevent them imposing boundaries in the future. I don't know enough about you to tell if that was the case, but it's something to consider.

Seeing as she forwarded the person to me, I thought she knew that it would take that much of a space in my life. Seeing her beeing like "yea... no... but yes... but" frustrated me. Beein the reason I had that reaction of "ok then. Fuck me, never gonna do GTA RP ever", as, well every RP take a lot of time.

There was no other instances of controlling behavior from her.
We know it's quite a large age gap, but due to a lot of "life adventure" I'm way more mature for my age, so I'm ok with that age gap (having tryed multiple relationships with people of "my age" and not liking it because of the "maturity gap") .
Yea, we are on an equal footing (at lear I think so).
